title: EvaluationReply
description: The policy worker's answer to a PolicyQuery whose sampling kind is evaluate (ADR-026 §5, ADR-010 §2): the policy's prior over the query's candidates and its value of the state, or a refusal (the same ErrorReply as a PolicyReply). Reader rules the profile cannot say, checked by the client: query_id and identity are the query's, and prior_ppm has one entry per candidate in the query's order. ROUNDING RULE (one, fixed): every number is the worker's float32 value widened exactly to float64 and then ppm = floor(x * 1000000 + 0.5) in IEEE 754 binary64 (round half up, toward positive infinity at a tie). The entries are rounded one by one and not renormalised, so prior_ppm sums to 1000000 only up to half a ppm per entry; a consumer must not assume the sum. value_ppm is the value head's output unclamped, so it may lie outside 0..1000000; a non-finite value, or one outside the integer range below, is a worker failure and never a reply.

query_id.description: The query_id of the PolicyQuery this answers.

RequestIdentity.description: Which request a decision answers (ADR-008 §4). A consumer drops a recommendation unless request_seq and request_hash both match, and rqid too when both carry one.

request_seq.description: Areneon's 1-based count of the requests one player has received in this battle, including wait requests.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical request JSON without rqid (ADR-008 §4): lowercase hex.

rqid.description: The Showdown server's request id; present only on the server path (A2), never hashed.

Evaluation.description: The policy's prior and value for one request, as integer millionths under the rounding rule of this contract.

identity.description: The request the query asked about.

prior_ppm.description: The probability of each candidate at temperature 1 with no truncation, in the query's candidate order; one entry per candidate (reader rule).

value_ppm.description: The value head's output for the state.

detail.description: A short reason, never the query's content.
